newsitem.title: USA: Equity Compression completes Ouachita buy.
newsitem.headline: Equity Compression completes Ouachita buy.

text.p: Equity Compression Services Corp said Thursday that it has completed its acquisition of Ouachita Energy Corp, a full-service contract compression company.
Under the terms of the agreement, Ouachita shareholders received 7.6 million shares of Equity's common stock and $24 million in a combination of debt assumption and cash.
The company said that Ouachita's expertise in operating larger horsepower equipment allows Equity to offer full contract compression services to its customers.
